# Doctor Scheduling Requirements Review Checklist

**Purpose**: Formal PR-review gate for the clarity, completeness, consistency, and measurability of doctor scheduling requirements, with emphasis on time rules and authorization/audit boundaries.
**Created**: 2026-08-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), and [API contract](../contracts/doctor-scheduling-api.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by `$speckit-checklist` from the feature context.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is reviewer-owned. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the requirement-quality criterion was reviewed and satisfied; it does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are recurring schedules, effective revisions, periods, breaks, leave, exceptions, and derived slots each defined with their required data and relationships? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities; Data Model]
- [x] CHK002 Are the permitted schedule-management roles and the exact read/manage permissions defined beyond the term “authorized staff”? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, FR-009]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for a doctor associated with more than one branch, including how staff choose the branch-scoped schedule? [Completeness, Plan §Research: Branch-scoped schedules]
- [x] CHK004 Are inactive-doctor schedule and availability rules consistently documented in the specification rather than only the design data model? [Gap, Data Model §Validation and concurrency]

## Time and Slot-Rule Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the branch IANA timezone requirement defined with validation and a migration/default-data policy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010; Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK006 Are daylight-saving gap and overlap semantics defined for local working times and resulting slot instants? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK007 Are the slot-alignment origin and the handling of a break that cuts through a slot explicitly defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, FR-003]
- [x] CHK008 Are the “no cross-midnight periods” rule and same-local-date leave/exception semantics consistent with the branch-timezone rule? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases; FR-005, FR-010]
- [x] CHK009 Are range limits for available-slot requests specified so the two-second 31-day target has an enforceable request boundary? [Gap, Spec §SC-002]

## Precedence, Revision, and Conflict Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Are leave, exception, and effective-recurring-revision precedence rules complete and non-conflicting for every requested local date? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002a, FR-005–FR-008]
- [x] CHK011 Is the behavior defined when leave overlaps a date-specific exception, including whether both records may coexist and what staff are told? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, FR-007]
- [x] CHK012 Are replacement versus amendment semantics for an effective-dated revision unambiguous, including duplicate effective dates? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002a, FR-013]
- [x] CHK013 Are version-token requirements specified consistently for recurring revisions, leave, and exceptions, including create, edit, and delete operations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013; API Contract §Endpoints]

## Authorization and Audit Requirements

- [x] CHK014 Are production fail-closed behavior and the test-only trusted identity boundary stated consistently across all scheduling endpoints? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context; API Contract introduction]
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements explicit that actor identity, role, and authorized scope cannot be accepted from request headers, body, query parameters, or path values as proof of authorization? [Completeness, API Contract introduction]
- [x] CHK016 Are hospital, branch, doctor ownership, and role-scope decisions defined for every write and read operation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009; API Contract §Endpoints]
- [x] CHK017 Are unauthenticated, forbidden, and not-found response requirements defined so disclosure behavior is deliberate and consistent? [Clarity, API Contract §Errors]
- [x] CHK018 Is the audit-event content specified to include the trusted staff reference and change type while excluding unnecessary schedule or personal data? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011; Plan §Constitution Check]

## Acceptance and Operational Quality

- [x] CHK019 Can each success criterion identify its measurement population, test data/profile, and observation method without relying on unspecified “representative” conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-005]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for migration failure, invalid pre-existing branch timezone data, and rollback/forward-recovery expectations? [Gap, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK021 Are API response ordering, local-time fields, and UTC instant fields specified sufficiently for consumers to compare deterministic available-slot results? [Clarity, API Contract §Endpoints]
- [x] CHK022 Are appointment booking, reservation, capacity, and double-booking requirements explicitly excluded without leaving dependencies on this feature ambiguous? [Scope, Spec §FR-012; Plan §Summary]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after PR review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when requirements need clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` may read checklist state but must not change these markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
